name: info.aicontest/aicontest
title: AI Contest
description: Open AI competitions and hackathons: prizes, deadlines and eligibility, verified on official sites

tools.name: search_contests
tools.description: Search AI competitions and hackathons open for entry worldwide. Returns each contest's id, title, organizer, platform, format, prize pool, deadline in UTC, days left, who can enter, any restriction, tags, and links to the listing and the official site.

keyword.description: Matches title, summary, organizer, platform and tags, for example agent, Kaggle, vision

sort.description: deadline: soonest first (default); prize: largest prize pool first

closing_within_days.description: Only contests closing within this many days

exclude_chinese_platforms.description: true to skip contests on Chinese platforms (Tianchi, DataFountain, Huawei Cloud, PaddlePaddle), which usually need a Chinese phone number or ID

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging

tools.name: get_contest
tools.description: Full details of one contest: official site, timeline in UTC, prizes, team size, number of entrants, who can enter, restrictions and the full description.

tools.name: get_ai_brief
tools.description: The ready-made brief for one contest: a complete description written for an AI assistant, ending with instructions to check the official site, judge whether it is worth doing, plan how to do it with AI and schedule backwards from the deadline. Use it when the user asks whether a contest is worth it, how to do it with AI, or how to prepare.
